candidate_merges.message: Show repository and ref in template picker group headings (#21831) ## Description Configured template sources currently appear in the `aspire new` picker under a friendly name or alias alone, making it difficult to tell which repository and ref will supply a template. Show that provenance directly in each source heading while retaining the friendly name. Git headings now use `Name (repository @ ref)`. An omitted ref is explicitly displayed as `default branch`, rather than guessing a branch name
